name: SCUT-COUCH2009
description: A comprehensive online unconstrained Chinese handwriting database with an associated benchmark evaluation protocol for handwriting recognition.
reputation: A well-known and widely cited dataset within the Chinese handwriting-recognition community, used as a standard benchmark for unconstrained online Chinese handwriting.
notes: Non-LLM benchmark focused on handwriting OCR; moderate dataset size by modern standards; established evaluation protocol but some subsets may be easier and risk saturation; potential for label noise and domain-specific biases.
